name: web10
description: Web10 jobs monorepo: extraction API, PostgreSQL job index, React search UI and the shared jobs contract.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @web10/shared && npm run start:dev -w @web10/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @web10/shared && npm run build -w @web10/api && npm run build -w @web10/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @web10/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
